name: se
description: Refine and study ideas, turn them into clear Feature plans, deliver reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Refine ideas, run studies, plan Features, and deliver changes.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a graph-first software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge, Grilling sharpens a topic or handoff through one-question-at-a-time interviews, and Study composes both before orchestrating a read-only investigation in one visible App controller or the current CLI session with optional native subagents. Idea captures proposals, while Feature admits reachable planning inputs and uses one explicitly profiled planner plus a small transient graph to publish evidence-backed Feature Plan Sets; unclear planning composes Grilling, and plans retain falsifiable acceptance criteria, Macro verification paths, provenance, and validation seams. Adversarial Review independently pressure-tests software changes without editing them. Implement validates selected local work and commits it without orchestration or publication. Delivery Features uses one visible graph orchestrator, coordinates reusable repository workers, composes Adversarial Review for candidate checks, and requires exact-head hosted Codex review before producing standalone or same-repository stacked pull requests. Successful delivery releases its tiny host-local repository claim before completion. Audit observes active SE work without making changes. Delivery Features leaves merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure to the user.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:grilling to sharpen a topic, $se:study to investigate it, or $se:learn to preserve knowledge.
Use $se:feature to turn related requests into Feature issues and Macro Tasks without writing code.
Use $se:adversarial-review for pressure-testing, $se:deliver-features for PRs, or $se:implement for local work.
